**Blog Title:**  
**Description:** optional, used as the post's subtitle -- leave blank if not needed  
**Publish date:** leave blank to use the date from the post's folder name  
**Location:** openscapes.org/blog, cross-post:  
**URL:** leave blank -- the post's URL is generated automatically  
**Authors:** first names, comma-separated, e.g. Ronny, Julie  
**Image:** filename of the cover image, e.g. cover.jpg -- upload the file itself to this doc's Drive folder  
**Categories:** comma-separated, e.g. blog, how-we-work -- see the known categories list at https://github.com/Openscapes/website-new/wiki/Adding-blog-posts#categories

Write the post body below this line.

Use Google Docs' Heading styles (Heading 2, Heading 3, ...) for section headings -- no need to bold them yourself.

Use Google Docs' "Quote" paragraph style for pull quotes -- they'll automatically get the blog's blue vertical line styling.

To add an image anywhere in the body, use three consecutive lines with the image's filename, a caption, and an accessible description, e.g. (remove the leading "ex: " from each line):

ex: image_name: cover.jpg

ex: caption_text: A caption describing the image

ex: alt_text: A longer accessible description of the image

The image file itself must be uploaded to this doc's Drive folder separately.
